summary: Smith & Nephew plc filed a Form 6-K on May 19, 2026, disclosing that activist investor Cevian Capital II GP Limited increased its aggregate voting rights to 11.183% as of May 14, 2026, up from a prior 11.014%. The holding is via Cevian Capital II Master Fund L.P. (10.006%) and Cevian II Co-Investment - Series P L.P. (1.178%). The filing is a UK TR-1 notification for transparency. No board recommendation or advisor is mentioned. This incremental stake, crossing no new threshold, signals potential engagement pressure. Watch for further 13D equivalence in the US, operational or strategic demands from Cevian, or a possible proxy fight.
